_comment: Team members to scan for new publications. Add one entry per researcher. ORCID is preferred. Optional fields: since_year (int, start of the scan window, default 2015); openalex_id (string) or openalex_ids (list), OpenAlex author entity IDs queried in addition to the ORCID, for people whose OpenAlex entity has no ORCID linked; pubmed_term (string, e.g. "Hall P[Author]"), overrides the PubMed audit's derived author term of surname plus first initials; _note (free text).
